name: Brute Coalitions
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Brute Courage
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Unwieldy
specialRules.description: Strikes last when charging.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Unwieldy Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fearless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.
